description: A modulo operator: it takes volts off a voltage, one helping at a time, until what is left falls under a ceiling you set, which strips octaves off a pitch and creases a waveform

params.text: Sets both the size of the helping taken off and, with OFFSET at centre, the ceiling the voltage is brought under; a whole number of volts from 1 to 5
Moves the ceiling away from the RANGE setting, one whole RANGE below it fully left and one whole RANGE above it fully right; it is ignored while anything is patched to the OFFSET input

inputs.text: The voltage to be folded down, treated one polyphonic channel at a time
Takes over the OFFSET knob while patched: a fifth of the voltage here becomes the offset, so 5V lifts the ceiling by 1V rather than by one RANGE

outputs.text: The folded voltage, carrying as many channels as the IN jack

notes: the fold is done on the size of the voltage and the sign is put back afterwards, so a negative input comes out negative.
with OFFSET hard left the ceiling falls to zero and every positive input is folded down to zero or below.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the OFFSET knob.
